create.name: Mountain Stream Meditation
create.bio:
Mountain Stream Meditation is an insight meditation community in Nevada City, in the Sierra Nevada foothills of Northern California. Its founding teacher, John Travis, trained for years with Tibetan and Theravada masters in Asia and later completed senior teacher training with Jack Kornfield; he began leading a weekly sitting group in the area in 1986. The group became a non-profit in 1994, and in 2013 it opened the Nevada City Insight Center on Zion Street, a remodelled property that now serves as its community temple. Adam Stonebraker, whose teaching draws on the Thai Forest lineage of Ajahn Chah, is resident guiding teacher, working with a council of local teachers.

The weekly rhythm includes a Monday evening talk with Adam or a visiting teacher, a Tuesday sit, an early-morning online group on weekdays and an open temple on Fridays, most of it in person and on Zoom. There are also half-day and daylong retreats, study series, two residential retreats a year, eco-dharma activities, a queer sangha and a Dzogchen circle. Much is offered by donation with sliding-scale fees for longer events, and recorded talks are shared on the website and YouTube.

courses.title: Bhāvanā: A Year of Committed Practice with Adam Stonebraker
courses.description: A year-long cohort for committed meditators led by Adam Stonebraker, working through concentration, the four foundations of mindfulness and the four heart qualities. Twelve monthly gatherings, three four-week workshops and three daylongs, in person or online, with personal meetings with the teacher. Entry is by application.
courses.price: Donation-based (monthly giving, no minimum or maximum)

free_resources.title: Rise & Reflect, Onward
free_resources.description: A half-hour online sitting group every weekday morning (Pacific time), peer-led with guidance from the centre's teachers: a short reading, then silent meditation, with optional sharing on Fridays. A small donation is suggested.

free_resources.title: Audio Talks
free_resources.description: Recorded Monday-night dharma talks from Mountain Stream by Adam Stonebraker, members of its teacher council and visiting insight teachers, plus older talks by founding teacher John Travis, free to stream.
